gold: Carcinoma erysipelatoides arising from triple-negative breast cancer

selector.rationale: pruritic erythema lesion with multiple nodules over the operation site and negative hormone receptor status support Carcinoma Erysipelatoides

rejected.label: Inflammatory Breast Cancer
rejected.why: lack of typical inflammatory breast cancer presentation and negative hormone receptors

rejected.label: Cutaneous Metastasis
rejected.why: clinical presentation and biopsy results more consistent with Carcinoma Erysipelatoides

rejected.label: Radiation Dermatitis
rejected.why: presence of carcinoma cells in dermal and subcutaneous lymphatic vessels contradicts radiation dermatitis
